question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Eagerly
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Eagerly"** means **with a great deal of enthusiasm, impatience, or keenness.** (उत्सुकता से)

 
 
• **Example: **The children waited **eagerly** for the start of the show.
 
 
 
• **"Keenly"** refers to **doing something with strong interest or enthusiasm.** (तीव्रता से)
 
 
• **Example: **She listened **keenly** to every detail of the story.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'eagerly' **is **'keenly'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stringently **(कठोरता से): In a strict or precise manner.

 
 
• **Example:** The rules were stringently enforced to ensure everyone's safety.
 
 
 
• **Dubiously **(संदेहपूर्वक ): In a doubtful or uncertain manner.
 
 
• **Example: **He looked at the proposal dubiously, unsure if it would work.
 
 
 
• **Playfully** (खिलवाड़ से): In a light-hearted or humorous manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The puppy barked playfully as it chased its tail.
 
 

36:Td52,

The correct answer is: **Option 1)**
